quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on maintaining Portland's high standards
quotes.excerpt: we trying to just keep our standard and that's playing hard every time we hit the floor
quotes.quote: I think I was just locking in, playing against ourselves. We trying to just keep our standard and that's playing hard every time we hit the floor. So we can't play down, we can't play up, we can't get too high, we can't get too low. So we just got to remain the Blazers.
